name: precision-rounding-inserted
description: Clean vault with deliberate rounding direction bug inserted in previewWithdraw
bug_description: previewWithdraw uses floor division (rounds down) instead of ceiling division (rounds up). ERC4626 spec requires ceiling for withdrawal share calculation to protect the protocol.

ground_truth.title: Wrong rounding direction in previewWithdraw allows users to burn fewer shares than entitled
ground_truth.root_cause: previewWithdraw rounds shares DOWN (floor) instead of UP (ceiling), violating ERC4626 spec
ground_truth.violated_invariant: withdrawing assets should never leave the withdrawer with more effective value than deposited
ground_truth.failure_predicate: user withdraws X assets by burning fewer shares than convertToShares(X) would require, enabling systematic extraction over many operations
